node.title: Budget-three fiber-two c=2 coupling and torsion meet at an actual denominator pair
node.statement: In the generic canonical c=2 denominator-mismatch chamber, let R_D be the degree-six resolvent of actual denominator-pair traces, K_O the degree-three outer invariant cubic, and Q_40-2 the official-order trace equation computed modulo K_O. Then G_2=gcd(K_O,R_D mod K_O,Q_40-2) is nonconstant exactly when an actual pair {A,B} has K_O((A+B)^2/(AB))=0 and (A/B)^(2^40)=1. Its distinct zeros are exactly all such pair traces and its degree is at most three. This exact selector removes outer-only false positives but does not impose canonical span, the gap equations, or cycle closure.
